facts.text: I am looking for mid-century modern design inspiration for a new bedroom dresser to replace my new one.
I want to incorporate key elements that define a mid-century modern dresser into my design.
I am considering a walnut dresser with an oil-based stain.
I think a satin finish would work better for my walnut dresser.
I think I will go with a satin finish for my walnut dresser.
I think I will go with brass accents and simple knobs for my walnut dresser.
I think I will start searching for inspiration online using design blogs or websites.
